Minimalist Matte Chrono 40mm — Precision Everyday Craftsmanship

bright sunlight, while the slim 10.2mm profile slides smoothly under shirt cuffs without bulk.
Powered by a reliable Japanese Miyota JS25 quartz movement, it delivers accurate chronograph timing and long battery life.
